playwright_env_note: Direct `page.goto('https://.../share.html#<long-b64url>')` fails with chrome-error://chromewebdata (ERR_FAILED) in the container browser — HTTP/2 301 + long URL fragment appears to trip Playwright/Chromium. Curl confirms 301→200 works. RFC 7231 §7.1.2 guarantees real browsers preserve the fragment. Workaround for tests: navigate to the post-redirect URL /share#<fragment> directly (this mirrors what the user's browser sees after the 301). Do NOT report as an app bug.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 5 days via localStorage with structure {events:[{sym:0,ts:...}], wellness:{0:6,1:7,2:7,3:3,4:7,5:5}, note:'seed N'} at key 'idgaf_day_YYYY-MM-DD'. Required to make weeklySummaryText non-empty so openShareQrModal proceeds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The GH Pages fix in share-qr.js line 96 (qrUrl uses share.html not /share) is confirmed working end-to-end on Cloudflare/Emergent. openShareQrModal early-returns 'Nothing to share yet' if #weeklySummaryText is empty — always seed days first and call showView('dashboard') to trigger renderDashboard() which populates the summary. To capture qrUrl from tests, monkey-patch window.drawShareQr because _sharePayload is a module-private let. To decrypt in Playwright, avoid navigating to /share.html#<long-fragment> (container Chromium ERR_FAILs on that combo); navigate to /share#<fragment> which is the post-301 URL a real browser reaches.
rca of the issue: Fix under review: /app/frontend/js/share-qr.js:96 now emits `${origin}share.html#${packed}`. RCA: GitHub Pages serves static .html files directly and has NO clean-URL rewrite, so /share (no extension) returns 404 on GH Pages. Cloudflare/Emergent DOES 301 /share.html → /share, and fragments are preserved across redirects (RFC 7231). Emitting share.html therefore works on BOTH hosts — the essence of the runtime fix. Verified: curl HEAD /share.html → 301 to /share; /share → 200 with the encrypted-handout page; decrypt flow returns clinical summary text.
